d: Short, messy platinum white hair with long bangs that partially cover the eyes. The eyes are a pale, muted grey with a calm, distant expression. The face appears as a mature youth with a slender build. The outfit consists of a white tunic with brown embroidered patterns, light beige trousers, and black boots, all layered under a long brown coat with fur-lined cuffs and a heavy black shawl featuring white fringed edges and deer motifs. Signature details include a brown cord necklace, a black neck warmer, a small white fluffy creature perched on the shoulder, and a wooden palette held in a black-gloved hand.
